title: About
summary: About Allen Technical Solutions: our experience, approach and values.
keywords: about company team founder story mission values approach
text: Who we are Engineering for people who build Allen Technical Solutions is an engineering firm with almost 30 years of experience in controls, automation, testing and validation. Our work spans the automotive, industrial and transportation industries. Our background is in leading engineering teams through complex technical programs. We have built real-time control systems, calibration strategies and automated test environments. We focus on reducing technical risk, improving product quality and turning customer requirements into solutions that scale. Electrical and communication engineering foundation Six Sigma-style process improvement Functional safety and cybersecurity for software releases Customer support across North America and Europe We pair that foundation with modern design, simulation and automation tools. That lets us take on software, app and web projects alongside traditional engineering. Every deliverable is reviewed and tested before it ships. Based in Indianapolis, Indiana, working with clients anywhere. Experience Where our experience comes from Controls & Automation Real-time embedded control systems, Linux-based platforms, industrial communications, custom I/O and machine safety. Test & Validation Automated test environments, hardware-in-the-loop simulation, data acquisition, test instrumentation, calibration and product validation. Engineering Leadership Leading engineering teams, OEM customer engineering, standards compliance and release management. Our approach How every project runs Listen Understand the real problem, not just the requested feature. Specify Write down requirements and acceptance criteria together. Build & test Design, code and test in short, visible increments. Verify & support Check the work against your acceptance criteria, document it, then keep it supported. Values What we hold ourselves to Integrity Honest estimates, plus a straight answer when something isn't worth building. Precision Measured results and work that is checked before it ships. Clarity Plain-language updates and documentation you can use. Craft Pride in clean designs, clean code and lasting solutions.
